extra_vocab.en: the glass part of a lamp that gives light
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見在辦公室維修、採購與飯店設施的情境，多半指「燈泡」，常說 light bulb。

example.en: The storeroom has boxes of bulbs in different sizes.
example.zh: 儲藏室裡有各種尺寸的燈泡好幾箱。

example.en: A light bulb above the entrance is not working.
example.zh: 入口上方的一個電燈泡壞了。

example.en: Please call maintenance if you need to replace a bulb.
example.zh: 如果需要更換燈泡，請聯絡維修部門。

example.en: We switched to an energy-saving bulb to lower electricity costs.
example.zh: 我們改用節能燈泡來降低電費。

examples.en: The bulb in the meeting room stopped working this morning.
examples.zh: 會議室的燈泡今天早上壞了。

examples.en: Please add one spare bulb to the supply list.
examples.zh: 請在耗材清單上多加一顆備用燈泡。

examples.en: The hotel replaced every old bulb to cut its power costs.
examples.zh: 飯店把所有舊燈泡都換掉，以降低用電成本。

confusable.diff: bulb 是「燈泡」；bulk 是「大量」，in bulk 指大批購買，兩字只差最後一個字母。

example.en: We buy office supplies in bulk to save money.
example.zh: 我們大量採購辦公用品以節省開支。

example.en: She put a small lamp on the reception desk.
example.zh: 她在接待櫃檯上放了一盞小檯燈。

example.en: The light switch is on the wall next to the door.
example.zh: 電燈開關在門旁邊的牆上。

example.en: The office uses less electricity after the new lights were installed.
example.zh: 安裝新燈具後，辦公室用電量降低了。

senses.en: the glass part of a lamp that gives light
senses.distinguish: 出現在電燈、維修、採購的情境，指燈泡。

example.en: He changed the bulb in the hallway before the guests arrived.
example.zh: 他在客人抵達前換了走廊的燈泡。

senses.en: a round part of some plants that you put in the ground
senses.distinguish: 和 flower、garden、plant 等字一起出現時，指植物的球莖。

example.en: The garden shop sells flower bulbs for spring planting.
example.zh: 園藝店販售春季種植用的花卉球莖。

extra_vocab.en: a person who works in business, especially a manager or owner
extra_vocab.note: 是不分性別的說法，比 businessman、businesswoman 更中性，常見於報導、活動公告與酒店服務介紹。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 複數通常寫成 businesspeople（不是 businesspersons）。

example.en: Hundreds of businesspeople will attend the trade fair next week.
example.zh: 數百位商務人士將參加下週的貿易展。

example.en: She became a successful businessperson before the age of thirty.
example.zh: 她在三十歲前就成為成功的商人。

example.en: A local businessperson donated money to the new library.
example.zh: 一位當地商人捐錢給新的圖書館。

example.en: We need an experienced businessperson to lead the new office.
example.zh: 我們需要一位經驗豐富的商業人士來帶領新辦公室。

examples.en: Every businessperson should read the contract carefully before signing.
examples.zh: 每位商務人士簽約前都應該仔細閱讀合約。

examples.en: The hotel offers a quiet lounge for the busy businessperson.
examples.zh: 飯店為忙碌的商務人士提供一間安靜的交誼廳。

examples.en: The magazine interviewed a businessperson who started three companies.
examples.zh: 雜誌訪問了一位創辦過三家公司的商人。

similar.diff: businessman 指男性商人；businessperson 不分性別，較中性。

example.en: The businessman checked his schedule before the evening meeting.
example.zh: 那位男商人在晚間會議前檢查了他的行程。

similar.diff: entrepreneur 強調「自己創業的人」；businessperson 指從事商業工作的人，範圍更廣。

example.en: The young entrepreneur started her own software company last year.
example.zh: 那位年輕的創業家去年創辦了自己的軟體公司。

example.en: The sales executive flew to Seoul for a client meeting.
example.zh: 業務主管飛到首爾去開客戶會議。

example.en: Our client asked for a new price estimate.
example.zh: 我們的客戶要求重新報價。

extra_vocab.en: very small living things that can sometimes cause disease
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在食品安全、餐廳衛生與清潔產品的情境，通常用複數 bacteria。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bacteria 是複數，單數是 bacterium；當主詞時動詞用複數，例如 Bacteria grow quickly。

example.en: Harmful bacteria can grow quickly in warm food.
example.zh: 有害細菌會在溫熱的食物中快速生長。

example.en: Hot water helps kill bacteria on kitchen tools.
example.zh: 熱水有助於殺死廚房用具上的細菌。

example.en: Cold storage slows bacteria growth in fresh products.
example.zh: 冷藏可以減緩生鮮產品中的細菌滋生。

examples.en: Workers must wash their hands to stop bacteria from spreading.
examples.zh: 員工必須洗手，以防止細菌擴散。

examples.en: The inspector tested the kitchen for bacteria last Tuesday.
examples.zh: 檢查員上週二檢測了廚房的細菌。

examples.en: This soap removes dirt and bacteria from your hands.
examples.zh: 這款肥皂可以去除手上的髒污和細菌。

confusable.diff: bacteria 是細菌，可用抗生素處理；virus 是病毒，兩者引起的疾病不同。

example.en: The flu is caused by a virus, not by bacteria.
example.zh: 流感是由病毒引起的，不是細菌。

example.en: Door handles can carry many germs in a busy office.
example.zh: 在忙碌的辦公室裡，門把可能帶有許多病菌。

example.en: Good hygiene is very important in a food factory.
example.zh: 在食品工廠裡，良好的衛生非常重要。

example.en: Clean tools help prevent infection in the clinic.
example.zh: 乾淨的器具有助於防止診所內的感染。

derived.link: anti-（對抗）+ bacterial，「對抗細菌的」，常見於洗手乳、清潔用品

extra_vocab.en: a person who makes bread and cakes
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在餐廳、飯店、麵包店與招聘廣告的情境，指烘焙麵包、蛋糕的人。

example.en: Several bakers joined the contest held at the city market.
example.zh: 好幾位麵包師傅參加了在城市市集舉辦的比賽。

example.en: The café buys all its bread from a local baker.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店的麵包全都向當地的麵包師傅購買。

example.en: The head baker checks every cake before it leaves the kitchen.
example.zh: 主廚級麵包師傅會在每個蛋糕離開廚房前檢查。

example.en: The new store plans to hire a baker next month.
example.zh: 新店打算下個月聘請一位麵包師傅。

examples.en: The hotel baker starts work at four o'clock every morning.
examples.zh: 飯店的麵包師傅每天早上四點開始工作。

examples.en: A famous baker will teach a free class at the festival.
examples.zh: 一位知名的麵包師傅將在慶典上教一堂免費的課。

examples.en: We are looking for a baker with two years of experience.
examples.zh: 我們正在找有兩年經驗的麵包師傅。

confusable.diff: baker 是做麵包的人；banker 是銀行家或銀行員，兩字只差一個字母。

example.en: The banker approved a loan so the baker could open another shop.
example.zh: 銀行員核准了貸款，讓麵包師傅能再開一家店。

example.en: The chef changes the menu every season.
example.zh: 主廚每一季都會更換菜單。

example.en: We ordered coffee and pastry for the morning meeting.
example.zh: 我們為早上的會議訂了咖啡和糕點。

example.en: The bakery bought a larger oven to meet demand.
example.zh: 麵包店買了一台更大的烤箱來應付需求。

derived.link: 基本動詞「烘烤」；bake + -er，做這件事的人，像 teach → teacher
bake + -ery，「做這件事的地方」，烘焙的地方就是麵包店

extra_vocab.en: a very large room used for dances, dinners, or big events
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店的公司晚宴、頒獎典禮與大型會議，指可容納很多人的大廳。

example.en: The hotel has two ballrooms on the first floor.
example.zh: 這間飯店一樓有兩間宴會廳。

example.en: We reserved a hotel ballroom for the product launch.
example.zh: 我們為產品發表會預訂了一間飯店宴會廳。

example.en: The grand ballroom is decorated with gold lights and flowers.
example.zh: 大宴會廳用金色燈飾和鮮花布置。

example.en: Please book the ballroom at least a month in advance.
example.zh: 請至少提前一個月預訂宴會廳。

examples.en: The company's annual dinner will start in the ballroom at seven.
examples.zh: 公司的年度晚宴七點在宴會廳開始。

examples.en: The ballroom can hold up to five hundred conference guests.
examples.zh: 這間宴會廳最多可容納五百位會議來賓。

examples.en: Guests moved to the ballroom after the ceremony ended.
examples.zh: 典禮結束後，賓客移往宴會廳。

similar.diff: banquet hall 專門辦宴席；ballroom 多在飯店，也能辦舞會、會議與頒獎典禮。

example.en: The wedding party will be held in the banquet hall.
example.zh: 婚宴將在宴會廳舉行。

example.en: We are still looking for a venue for the conference.
example.zh: 我們還在找研討會的場地。

example.en: The awards banquet begins at six thirty tonight.
example.zh: 頒獎晚宴今晚六點半開始。

example.en: A welcome reception will follow the opening speech.
example.zh: 開幕演說後會有歡迎酒會。
